ns2:section.sectionText: COMM 356 this semester is a part of the "ethnography of the university" initiative. Students will use ethnographic methods to study how the University of Illinois as an institution structures learning about gender and media, and the consumption of media. The course will involve group and individual projects to this end, with the goal of contributing to the ethnography of the university website. To this end the course will include training in ethnographic methods as well as materials about gender and media."
